summary_en: ¥15,000M upper limit, 4,200,000 shares (4.25% of S/O ex-treasury), market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, execution window 1 Jul 2026 – 24 Feb 2027. Rationale: flexible capital allocation in response to changing operating environment.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 26 June 2026, Kamigumi Co., Ltd. announced via board resolution the authorization of a treasury share acquisition program under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 4,200,000 shares (4.25% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥15,000 million through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 July 2026 and 24 February 2027. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing operating conditions. As of 31 May 2026, the company held 7,843,797 treasury shares against 98,733,040 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
